candidate_pool.novel_against: all historic LiTraj material IDs and exact chemical systems, excluding B4's three explored candidates
candidate_pool.groups: round-robin frozen low-fidelity index material-family metadata
candidate_pool.geometry: B4 bounded BVSE preprocessing, followed by exact periodic checks
candidate_pool.family_screen: anonymous reduced parent stoichiometry, space-group number and anion elements; compare with historical parent structures and within pilot

molecular_activation_ref: Varga-Umbrich et al 2026 arXiv:2605.03964v1 Appendix A and Eq. 6

features.main: mean image pooling, structures use mean all atom scalar activations and mean SOAP outer power spectra
sensitivity: concatenation resampled to fixed five-point reaction coordinate
features.soap: A1 settings with geometry SOAP and fixed element mu1nu1 compression available, primary element SOAP
features.historical_activation_cache: B3-A D0_17 Li site; full structure from same checkpoint using Eq.6-style pooling
features.reference_bank: one first canonical D0 frame per material; global and average over all Li for corresponding local acquisition anchor

historical.folds: leave one path out, with follow-up leave anion-family out

deadline_override: User removed the cutoff. Stop after specified B5-R outputs.
